body:
> From the review of PR #199 (#188, merged 2026-08-29). The repair works; these are its edges — and the root cause of the whole frozen-copy class (#138, #182, #188), found while reviewing.

## Why

`hkb init` writes every profile back to `.kanban/board.json` fully expanded — including `launch` — so a board that dropped its pin (by hand or by #188's repair) is re-frozen at the next `init` with whatever the default was that day. That is exactly how today's pins came to lack `{hook_settings}` and `allowed_tools` came to lack the builtins (#138): the file holds a copy of a default it never meant to own. Measured: `init` over this checkout's own board.json changes the file even with nothing to repair.

## What

1. **Init writes only what the human set** (`src/init.js` `boardProfiles`, `init`): profile keys equal to the shipped default are not written (`launch`, `allowed_tools`, `model`, `effort`, `max_in_progress` when unchanged); `loadBoard`'s deep-merge already supplies defaults at read time. A board.json that names only `{ "claude": { "effort": "medium" } }` stays that way across inits. Migration: an existing board whose expanded keys equal the current default gets them removed with one line saying so; keys that differ are kept (they are the human's pins) and reported.
2. **Validate a migrated `--effort`** (`src/init.js` ~298): a pin `--effort turbo` is written as `"effort": "turbo"`, init #1 exits 0, then every later command — including init #2 — exits 2. Validate against `EFFORT_LEVELS` before moving; on an invalid value fall back to the insert shape and say why.
3. **The drop-pin line never reads "added nothing but  over the default"** (`src/init.js` ~296): when `moved` is empty (a pin equal to the default minus placeholders, or a pin whose `--effort high` lost to an existing `effort: "medium"` field — silently discarded today) say what was kept and what was dropped; never claim a move that did not happen.
4. **Doctor's `launch hooks` fix text** (`src/doctor.js` ~268): "re-run `hkb init`, which inserts the placeholder / drops the pin" — not the by-hand edit, now that init does it (`docs/harnesses.md` already says so).
5. Nits: the insert shape leaves a launch with both `{model_args}` and a literal `--effort`, so a later profile `effort` renders `--effort` twice — migrate the literal when the field is unset, or warn; `src/board.js` ~452 keys the refusal on `launch[0] !== 'claude'` and the exception on the profile name `claude-action` — key both on the harness (`mode`), not the name; re-stamp `review-loop.md` (gc.js) and `tracks.md` (board.js), leftovers from #197.

## Done when

- `hkb init` twice over a board that sets only `effort` leaves the file byte-identical and pin-free; doctor clean.
- A pin `--effort turbo` → insert shape + one line naming the invalid value; nothing invalid is ever written.
- Fixtures for the empty-`moved` cases print an accurate line. `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (init output changed).
goal: board.json never carries a pinned launch the human did not write, a migrated effort value is validated before it is written, the repair line always says what it did, and doctor's fix for a stale pin is one command
title: hkb init must not re-freeze the expanded launch into board.json; validate a migrated --effort; say what the drop-pin repair kept; doctor's fix says re-run init
